messages:
Alyssa: Heads-up — we need a short migration playbook for the v1 -> v2 API sunset that covers model swap fallbacks, embed dim changes, and the small SDK param rename. Can we agree owners for the code snippets and the canary rollout notes?

Jordan: I can own the SDK snippet edits and the quick diff examples. planning to open a PR tonight. will call out breaking param rename + example before/after.

Kevin: I'll take the model fallback guidance and the routing policy section (how to configure automatic fallback to cheaper variant). Will also add a short bit about metrics to watch during rollout.

Vikram: @Jordan quick ask — can you include the `compat-shim` example? we need a one-liner that people can drop in if they can't upgrade immediately. something like: 
```js
// compat shim: translate old params to v2 client
if (opts.streaming === undefined && opts.stream) opts.streaming = opts.stream;
client.v2.call({ model: opts.model || 'rwd-v2-small', ...opts });
```

Jordan: yup — adding a `compat-shim.md` snippet. also will add a note about removing it after 90 days.

Alyssa: Docs-bot — can you create a checklist doc in the PR template that forces these items? we keep forgetting to add smoke tests and embed dim changes. :pray:

docs-bot: Created checklist template entry `migration-playbook-items` and attached to PRs that touch /migration or /sdk examples. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5021

Kevin: On embed dims — we should add a migration matrix: old_embedding_dim -> new_embedding_dim (and a small script to convert vectors). I'll add a one-file tool under `scripts/convert_vectors.py` and example command.

Vikram: +1. add a short compatibility note for similarity search aliases (IF you previously used `embed_model: rwd-embed-v1` set alias to `rwd-embed-v2` and reindex). include a sample reindex command.

Jordan: PR draft opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5021 — includes before/after SDK snippets, compat-shim, and a TOC stub for rollout docs. Tagging reviewers: @Alyssa @Kevin @Vikram

Alyssa: Quick content nit — please keep the top-level migration doc to one page with anchors. We want a short executive summary for product and a checklist for engs. Longer details can live in linked subpages.

Kevin: I'll add the telemetry section to the checklist: token-rate changes, p95 latency, embedding drift (sample eval queries). Also adding a recommended canary cadence (5% -> 20% -> 50% -> 100% over 48h) and rollback triggers.

Vikram: small UX note for snippets — prefer language-agnostic pseudocode for the fallback logic plus 1-2 concrete JS/TS examples. avoids duplicate maintenance.

Jordan: Will do. also adding a snippet header block in each example that calls out the last-tested SDK commit and model pin (e.g., `tested_on: docs@3f2a1d, model: rwd-v2-small@v1`).

Alyssa: Action items:
- Jordan: finish PR and add compat-shim + snippet headers (due EOD PDT)
- Kevin: add model fallback section, reindex guide, telemetry checklist (due tomorrow)
- Vikram: add reindex command and pseudo fallback logic + review PR
- Alyssa: prep exec summary and coordinate release notes copy

Jordan: noted. ping me in this thread if anyone sees a missing edge case (e.g., streaming framing differences).

Kevin: One edge: streaming framing for partial tokens changed slightly between v1 and v2 for the `stream` flag. I'll add a short example showing `on('data', chunk)` handling differences.

Vikram: ok to include a tiny test harness example that asserts embedding dims and streaming event shape. makes smoke tests easy for customers.

Alyssa: Perfect. after PR merges, we'll queue a docs redirect and coordinate a short blog blurb.

Jordan: merging checklist: smoke tests passed locally, snippets validated in node+ts, and docs-bot checklist green. will request final reviews in the PR now. :rocket:
